SELECT  
	DocumentCode= 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 10))),
	Type = 'Sales',
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1, 
	doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100),
	salesman = dbo.users.username ,
	remarks=saleledger.remarks ,
	totaldiscount=dbo.saleledger.flatdisc + Round(Sum (( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc)), 2)  + Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2),
	realamount=sum(Round(saledetail.packprice/ISNULL(saledetail.packunits ,1),2) * saledetail.looseqty),
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
	accountfor=dbo.saleledger.accountfor,
	impactinventory=dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	saleinvcode= NULL
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,   
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users  
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode between :ar_StartInv and :ar_EndInv)and
	( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ar_retailtype, :ar_cashtype, :ar_credittype ) ) and
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )  
					
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1, 
	dbo.saleledger.accountfor,
	dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	dbo.accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username ,
	dbo.saleledger.remarks
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	DocumentCode= 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 10))),
	Type = 'Sales',
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1, 
	doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	amount =  Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (( sd.looseqty  * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * .01)) + (sd.looseqty  * sd.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Sum (Round( sd.looseqty   * (sd.saleprice  - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (sd.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100),
	salesman = dbo.users.username ,
	remarks=saleledger.remarks ,
	totaldiscount=dbo.saleledger.flatdisc + Round(Sum (( sd.looseqty  * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * .01)) + (sd.looseqty  * sd.itemflatdisc)), 2)  + Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty   * (sd.saleprice  - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (sd.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2),
	realamount=sum(Round(sd.packprice/ISNULL(sd.packunits ,1),2) * sd.looseqty),
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round (sd.looseqty * sd.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * sd.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
	accountfor=dbo.saleledger.accountfor,
	impactinventory=dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	saleinvcode= NULL
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd,   
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users  
WHERE 
	( DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode between :ar_StartInv and :ar_EndInv)and
	( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ar_retailtype, :ar_cashtype, :ar_credittype ) ) and
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode ) and  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )  
					
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1, 
	dbo.saleledger.accountfor,
	dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	dbo.accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username ,
	dbo.saleledger.remarks
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	DocumentCode= 'SR-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(dbo.srledger.srinvcode, 10))),
	TYPE = 'Sales Return',
	invcode     = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.srledger.date,    
	flatdisc    = -dbo.srledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = -dbo.srledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = -dbo.srledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.srledger.discperc, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.srledger.invgstperc1, 
	doctype = Case dbo.srledger.srcatcode When 6 Then 'Cash' When 7 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	amount =  -Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = -Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty  * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = -Sum (Round( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty  ) * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100)     ,
	salesman = dbo.users.username ,
	remarks=srledger.remarks ,
	totaldiscount= -(dbo.srledger.flatdisc + Round(Sum (( dbo.srdetail.looseqty  * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01))), 2) + Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.saleprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100), 2)),
	realamount= -Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice), 2),
	itemsalestax = - (Sum (Round ( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty + dbo.srdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - dbo.srdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.srdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )),
	accountfor=dbo.srledger.accountfor,
	impactinventory='N',
	saleinvcode= dbo.srledger.saleinvcode
FROM 
	dbo.srledger, 
	dbo.srdetail,   
	dbo.accounts,
	users  
WHERE 
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode between :ar_StartSRInv and :ar_EndSRInv) and
	( dbo.srledger.srcatcode IN (:ar_retailSRtype, :ar_cashSRtype ,:ar_creditSRtype) )and
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ) and  
	( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and 
	( dbo.srledger.salesmancode=users.usercode)           

GROUP BY 
	dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.srledger.date,   
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
	dbo.srledger.discperc,  
	dbo.srledger.salestax, 
	dbo.srledger.srcatcode, 
	dbo.srledger.invgstperc1,
	dbo.srledger.accountfor,
	dbo.accounts.name ,
	dbo.srledger.saleinvcode ,   
	dbo.users.username ,
	dbo.srledger.remarks
ORDER BY 
	Type,
	invcode ASC,   
	DATE ASC

objects.name: compute_6
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(   if(Type = 'Sales', amount - realamount , 0) for all)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(   if(Type = 'Sales', amount - realamount , 0) for all)

objects.name: netamount
objects.expression: Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  + c_salestaxvalue
